svg.text: CLOSE THE DEAL / OFFICE LAYOUT STUDY
PLAN / measured lower floor • TARGET CONCEPT • 15 NOV 2026
One fixed island; one dependable ring; diagonally offset cross-cut.
40 px = 1m at native resolution / 4m grid / NW origin
Unity mapping: (x, y-plan) → (X, height, −y-plan) • doors 1.2 × 2.4m • walls 0.2m / partitions 0.1m
Blue hatch = upper void; pale blue ends = 2.4m landings; dashed guard opens at the stair ends.
L / H cobalt R electric blue
C muted violet A cool teal
